title: Collect an online order at the dog shop
brief: Review the customer behavior before choosing how to implement it.

workflow.name: BDD
constraints: Agree on observable customer behavior before implementation.
These scenarios are planned examples, not executed test results.

blocks.text: Customers can buy online and collect their order when the shop confirms it is ready. The confirmation must make the next action clear.

items.label: Given
items.detail: An order is paid and the shop has packed it.

items.label: When
items.detail: A staff member marks the order ready for pickup.

items.label: Then
items.detail: The customer receives the collection address, opening hours and order reference.

items.label: Given
items.detail: The order has not been marked ready.

items.label: When
items.detail: The customer opens the collection instructions.

items.label: Then
items.detail: Show that preparation is still in progress; do not claim the order is ready.

blocks.text: We still need to agree how the shop handles collection outside its published opening hours.
